proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ H _ _ _ T C hT hC
  have hsym : (T : H →ₗ[𝕜] H).IsSymmetric := ContinuousLinearMap.isSelfAdjoint_iff_isSymmetric.mp hT
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [T.norm_eq_iSup_rayleighQuotient hsym]
    refine ciSup_le fun x => ?_
    by_cases hx : x = 0
    · simpa [hx] using hC
    have hp : 0 < ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.rayleighQuotient, abs_div, abs_of_pos hp, div_le_iff₀ hp]
    exact (RCLike.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (h x)
  · intro h x
    calc ‖inner 𝕜 (T x) x‖ ≤ ‖T x‖ * ‖x‖ := norm_inner_le_norm _ _
      _ ≤ (‖T‖ * ‖x‖) * ‖x‖ := by gcongr; exact T.le_opNorm x
      _ ≤ (C * ‖x‖) * ‖x‖ := by gcongr
      _ = C * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by ring
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 H] [CompleteSpace H] (T : H →L[𝕜] H) (C : ℝ), ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T = T → 0 ≤ C → ((∀ x, ‖inner 𝕜 (T x) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ 2) ↔ ‖T‖ ≤ C)
